segments.src: C:/Users/immex/Documents/_MyFiles/_The Nauti Yachti LLC/Photos/02 Charters/_By charter/2026-06-09 Nagdy/20260609_200803_a42ec301.mp4
segments.note: THE CLOSE. NAGDY, sunset, tube clear on the water with a guest watching. 2128x2832 source, so a 1.30x punch-in still DOWNSCALES to 720 wide and costs nothing. Longest hold in the cut, because eight reference videos held their best shot rather than cutting away from it. Crop centre moved right and down after verification: at cx 0.52 the tower and board rack sat across the left of every frame. The sunset and the tube are centre-right, so the crop follows them - the tower-dominates-the-frame trap, caught on the output rather than in the source.
